name: Llama-Karmx-Indic-Embedding-bge-m3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-23.

benchmarks.name: IndicQARetrieval nDCG@10 (macro, 10 Indic languages)
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Language | bge-m3 | this model | d |', row Macro: bge-m3 0.7172 vs this 0.7377 (+0.0205, 95% CI +0.0178 to +0.0233), 16,775 queries, pytrec_eval, exact top-100, no prompts, 512 tokens. Both benchmarks held out from training and model selection. Every per-language row higher (smallest gain Hindi +0.0165).

benchmarks.name: Belebele retrieval nDCG@10 (macro, 10 Indic languages)
benchmarks.config: Same card, Belebele retrieval table, row Macro: bge-m3 0.8899 vs this 0.8985 (+0.0085), 9,000 human-translated questions, question->passage. No language worse.
